meta.title: One piece is under control
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)
meta.change_reason: ILLUSTRATIVE content authored to exercise the drill loop, the scoring engine and the interface end to end. Derived only from public open-source material on space domain awareness practice, per the flight plan's public-sources rule. It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

prompt: A parent object with several associated objects, one of which changes its departure rate. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Range from the parent against time for each associated object. Several pieces depart at fixed rates; one departs, then changes its rate part-way through and holds the new rate.
accepted_first_actions: assess whether any piece is manoeuvring
check whether any piece is manoeuvring
assess whether a piece is under control
expert_cue: A piece that changes its own rate is under control, and debris is not. One controlled piece settles the question; a piece that does not manoeuvre settles nothing.
